title: JaccDiv: A Metric and Benchmark for Quantifying Diversity of Generated Marketing Text in the Music Industry

live_model.evidence: 'We choose G-Eval [17], a chain-of-thought driven prompt-based metric that uses GPT-4.' footnote 5: 'GPT-4-turbo-1106'

prompt.location: G-Eval-style CoT prompt for Engagingness/Fluency/Naturalness/Informativeness scoring (method described; exact G-Eval template is a known published prompt)

claim.metric: none reproducible (the underlying judge model is a retired preview snapshot)

data.source: 359 manually filtered band/artist marketing-text samples with human-written references

notes: The paper pins its GPT-4 judge to the November 2023 preview snapshot 'gpt-4-turbo-1106', which is a dead preview, not one of the still-callable identifiers; GPT-4 here is only ever a role-A G-Eval judge, not the generation subject (generation baselines use Llama.cpp-hosted open models).
